title: Card Spec
description: Schema for evidence-card specifications authored by humans and stored as YAML under target-contracts/cards/. Validates the *authoring surface* of a card (the slots a card author fills in); the runtime emission surface (validation_state, provenance) is validated by card_output.schema.json. See plan section 'Evidence Card Framework' (A2) and the compose-dashboard behavioral spec (B1) for the runtime semantics of the fields below.

card_id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier for this card across versions. Same card_id + same version + same resolved inputs + same release_pin must produce byte-identical deterministic-field output (card-invariance discipline, A2).

version.description: Semantic version of this card spec. Bumps with method/threshold changes. Pre-release suffixes (-rc, -beta) allowed.

question.description: One-sentence statement of what this card answers. May contain {} template-string interpolations resolved at compose time (e.g., {target.symbol}, {indication.label}). Note: these are NOT CEL predicates; they are template-string substitutions performed during card rendering.

applies_when.description: List of CEL-compatible simple-predicate-subset strings. ALL predicates must evaluate to true (logical AND) for the card to be in scope. Cards that fail applies_when are excluded from the dashboard at compose time, NOT run-and-flagged. Evaluator grammar specified in B1 'compose-dashboard behavioral spec' subsection (2). Context-object schema specified in subsection (3).

derived_from.description: OPTIONAL. Declares this card as a DERIVED card whose method reads upstream cards' outputs (instead of, or in addition to, raw data products). Each entry names an upstream card_id. The reachability validator uses this list to verify the upstream cards exist and emit the fields this card reads.

required_inputs.description: Catalog refs the card consumes. Each entry resolves at compose time against the active data_mode (latest_approved | pinned | exploratory). May be empty ONLY for COMPOSED cards (cards that declare `derived_from:` upstream card_ids); leaf cards must declare at least one product_id. Composed-card empty-array eligibility is checked by the cross-reference validator, not the JSON Schema.

product_id.description: Registered product identifier (matches a product_id in target-contracts/vocabularies/products.yaml).

indication.description: OncoTree code or {indication} template placeholder resolved from the dashboard context.

release_pin.description: Specific manifest_id (for pinned mode) or {release_pin} template placeholder.

subgroup_catalog.description: Subgroup-catalog manifest_id, for cards that stratify by molecular subgroup.

optional.description: When true, this input is non-blocking — the card runs even if the product is unavailable, and emits 'data_unavailable' labels for fields derived from it. Useful for companion datasets (e.g. RNAi as a companion to CRISPR). Default: false (input is required).

methods.description: Method CLIs the card invokes. Methods are deterministic. Cards do not call models or web APIs directly.

call.description: Method CLI name (matches a method module in the methods repo, e.g., 'dge-deseq2', 'depmap-chronos'). Resolved to a subprocess invocation by compose-dashboard.

args.description: Keyword arguments passed to the method CLI. Values may contain {target}, {indication}, {release_pin}, {subgroup_spec} template placeholders.

outputs.description: Declarative description of what the card emits. The shape here defines what populates summary.json + figure.svg + plot_data.parquet for this card.

summary_fields.description: Names of fields that must be present in the card's emitted summary.json. Used by compose-dashboard's post-invocation validation (B1 § compose-dashboard subsection 5) to gate the validation_state. Each entry may be a bare string (biology-agnostic field, emitted unconditionally) OR an object with `name` + optional `lens_conditional_on` marker (field emitted only when a specific optional lens is invoked — e.g. `adc_grade` gated on `modality` lens). Bare-string form is preserved for backward compatibility; the reviewer-driven arch upgrade A2 (2026-07-08) adds the object form to prevent lens-only fields from leaking into biology-first invocations.

name.description: Field name (same shape as bare-string form).

lens_conditional_on.description: When set, this field is emitted only when the named optional lens is invoked at runtime. The rules engine treats the field as absent when the lens is not invoked; downstream consumers (target-profile LLM synthesis, provenance.yaml) must handle absence gracefully. Enables clean separation between biology-first outputs (always emitted) and lens-conditional outputs (e.g., ADC/TCE letter grades gated on the modality lens).

description.description: Optional per-field description surfaced in the card manifest.

summary_fields_vocabulary.description: Optional: for categorical summary_fields, declare the exhaustive set of values the method may emit. Consumed by validators/validate_interpretation_rules.py to confirm rule (card_id, field, value) triples are reachable. Map of field_name (must appear in summary_fields) -> list of allowed string values. Cards may omit this during the pure-data transition; validator emits a warning rather than an error.

figure.description: Iter-1b single-figure declaration. Identifier for the canonical figure type emitted by this card. Backward-compatible with cards that emit one figure; for multi-figure cards (iter-2+), use the `figures` array instead.

figures.description: Iter-2 multi-figure declaration. Cards may emit multiple figures with different visual representations of the same underlying analysis (e.g., waterfall + histogram for a distribution). The renderer reads `preferred_surfaces` to pick which figure to embed per output surface. The method CLI emits ALL listed figures to staging; the framework's renderer chooses per-context.

id.description: Stable identifier for this figure variant (e.g., 'waterfall', 'histogram_kde').

preferred_surfaces.description: Which renderer surfaces should prefer this figure variant. Renderers iterate their surface and pick the first matching figure.

primary.description: If true, this is the default figure when no preferred_surfaces match. Exactly one figure per card should be primary.

plot_data.description: Identifier for the canonical plot_data.parquet schema this card emits (e.g., 'long_format_paired_samples'). Parquet schemas live in target-contracts/schemas/plot_data/.

interpretation_hints.description: Rules that map output metrics to a categorical interpretation_call. Evaluated in order; first matching rule wins. Predicates use the same CEL-compatible subset as applies_when (B1 § compose-dashboard subsection 2).

if.description: CEL-compatible predicate evaluated against the card's emitted summary fields (NOT against the dashboard context — interpretation predicates are scoped to summary fields only).

call.description: The interpretation label emitted when the predicate evaluates true (e.g., 'strong upregulation', 'not informative').

dominant.description: EG4 (iter-2): if true, this interpretation_call is treated as a DOMINANT signal in fit_level scoring. The synthesis layer's dominant-signal-plus-confirmation rule rates the modality 'strong' when ANY primary card emits a dominant call AND no primary card emits a non-informative call. Card-authors opt in per-call to mark which of their calls represent discovery-driving signal (e.g., 'lineage-restricted: single tissue', 'structurally druggable: covalent pocket', 'actionable alteration'). Cards without any dominant calls fall back to ratio-based scoring (current iter-1b behavior). Backward-compatible: absent or false → no behavior change.

thresholds.description: Named thresholds referenced by applies_when and interpretation_hints predicates (e.g., THRESHOLD.expression_p95_min). Extracted to a separate block per T1.5 — magic numbers in predicates are the failure mode this pattern guards against. Threshold names are referenced in predicates as THRESHOLD.<name>; the validate_cards.py validator checks referential integrity.

caveats.description: Known limitations of the question or methods. Surfaced in the rendered card panel and in the evidence_package's per-card block.

warning_predicates.description: Optional. Named warning predicates that fire (or don't fire) against the emitted output. When a predicate fires, the card's validation_state becomes 'passed_with_warnings' and the warning_id is surfaced in the dashboard. Predicates use the same CEL-compatible subset; evaluated against the card's emitted summary fields.

message.description: Human-readable message surfaced in the dashboard when this warning fires.

schema_version.description: Version of card.schema.json this spec validates against. Currently always 1; bumps when card.schema.json itself takes a breaking change.
